summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, a social hub, and authored lore destinations; player saves hold progression, gear, quests and homes, while tutorial0 is solo and ephemeral. Shared player behaviors, place simulations and reusable builders join authored scenes to generated spaces. Level 31 is a versioned Roller Rink with modular venue zones, now connected to Level 70's snowbound Froidetown; the Favi creator-assistant mod adds game-aware chat and tools on the god-mode rail.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's yellow maze, ecology, routes, landmarks, Christmas Area and stair anomalies; its objects.scene also carries the Favi brain row.
places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with simulated staff, shops, directory, arcade, payphones, player-home kiosk and Squeeze Play smoothie bar.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo, ephemeral) - character creation/waking, staged tutorial and HALOGEN handoff to Dina's lead.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station, breach, bots, hazards and recorder quest.
places/level1, level2, level02, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; Level 1 also generates spiral anomalies.

places/level31 (3D) - Roller Rink, cinema/DJ booth, east arcade, party room, rink cafe/snack bar, rental, Dottie's gift shop/skate loft, staff back room and new white Level 70 door; Awakening lighting configured.

places/level70 (3D; Froidetown) - snowy Canadian city on a planetoid: Kelpie Street, Burns Crescent, Calor Office Block, Noahtown, Parliament Hotel, Froston, Iceshed and Burns River; blue-hour snow/wind and Level 31 return door.

places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10, level11, level12, level13, level26, level27, spamton, testlab and remaining configured places - resident hubs, rentals, stories, hazards and other lore/test destinations; scenes supply authored objects.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings; config selects shared lighting.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
sim.js - global tick for body-style propagation and bounded incremental restyling of objects in occupied places.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, character creation, arrival, tutorial and Dina quest routing/tick.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - composed player HUD/menus and character status, including derived sanity cap and smoothie UI.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout, Christmas Area and stair-anomaly seeding.

places/level31/sim.js + scripts/lib/level31.js + scripts/lib/level31-parts.js; places/level70/sim.js + scripts/lib/level70.js + scripts/terrain70.js - versioned rink/venue and Froidetown map/terrain, arrivals and weather spine.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/destinations, home destinations, Level 70 display name and proximity-preload manifest.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric doors/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired hatch layout; threshold/sign geometry is shared by participating places.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - directed crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; dialogue data, npc-starters and npc-talk support conversations/checks.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall damage, material, drops and regrowth; place sims opt in with sweepProps/tickWalls.

scripts/lib/data/dlg-*.yml + scripts/lib/dialogue.js + scripts/lib/data/voice-cast.yml, voice-acted.yml + scripts/lib/voices.js - authored NPC talk/barks, performer assignments and recorded takes; scripts/meg-agent.js prefers per-NPC barks.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml + scripts/lib/rep.js + scripts/lib/rbox.js + scripts/lib/seat.js; mods/awakening/lib/* - character appearance/refitting, faction/rep, hitboxes and shared seating.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; body-style propagation and bounded incremental object restyling.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V, sw194, furrySpec, restyle, restyleQueue, restyleStep, restylePlace; character construction and refitting.
scripts/lib/level31.js - H, B, RINK, ZONES, ARRIVE, DOOR, BACK, onRink, L31_NAMES, zoneAt, SKATE, skateStep; venue geometry, area labels and rink movement.
scripts/lib/level31-parts.js - layParts; dispatches arcade, food, rental, shop, Side B, design and loft builders.
scripts/lib/level31-quest.js - QID/QNAME, NPC/object IDs, openCrate, useDeck, l31Choices, handleDialogueQuest31; Side B quest state and interactions.
scripts/lib/level31-arcade.js + level31-food.js - arcade ears/cardSlide/result/layArcade; food exports G, L31_FOOD, L31_ZONE_X, l31Order, layFood.
scripts/lib/level31-sideb.js + level31-design.js + level31-rental.js + level31-loft.js - GLB/FWD/laySideB, layDesign, layRental, layLoft; venue subarea builders.
scripts/lib/level70.js + scripts/terrain70.js - ARRIVE/HUT/STREET/ZONES/RIVER/L70_NAMES/zoneAt/wildness/SPOT/NPC map contract; heightAt/materialAt produce Level 70 ground and terrain materials.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position, tapes, currency and homeKeep; also owns furniture counts, skates, snacks and food effects.
scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - quests/qtrack/qdone; Dina quest/diary/cut/lead fields and legacy quest migration.
scripts/lib/level31-quest.js - player.state.l31q/l31route/l31qh and quest tape/card/check/ending fields; route consequences, faction rep, cents, payout and mixtape reward.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - remodQ, l02got/l02paint, fresh, capnAsk/capnFailed and Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation.

scripts/build.js + places/level5/sim.js - player homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built and reconstruction; scripts/l5-resident.js owns booking keys/room identity and place.state.l5rent exclusive-room ledger.
scripts/arcade-play.js + scripts/lib/felix-game.js - player.state.arcade/arcadeBest/felixBest; active game frames and input progression are in session state, consumed by arcade UI.
scripts/smoothie-player.js - player.state.cents, smoothieBook, smoothieBuff, smix/smoothieOpen/smoothieMsg and sCut; purchases/recipe discovery and timed buff ticking use smoothie data.

Enemy managers own AI/sneakTarget; scripts/lib/meg-agent.js owns NPC runtime combat/movement memory; places/level2/sim.js owns survBodyV and camp survivor replacement; Level 31 owns place.state.v31 and Level 70 owns its v70 plus per-layer version keys.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors; arcade-play.js and smoothie-player.js provide game-specific handlers.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics/weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js names and Level 31 zoneAt/L31_NAMES.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place; kiosk resolves booked Level 5 home IDs.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scaling.
tutorial0 HALOGEN cut → scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js; diaries/cuts/clues across Level 26, Level 1, Level 3 and Gamma advance player.state.dinaQ and play recorded voices.
scripts/build.js placement/removal → homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built; Level 5 sim restores separately; l5-resident booking → player l5home/l5room and place.state.l5rent, hub kiosk routes per room.
Level 2 sim l2-to-l31 → scripts/level-door.js to level31#l31-from-l2; Level 31 l31-back → level2#l2-from-l31; quest-route.js maps both directed crossings.

Level 31 l31-to-l70 trigger → scripts/level-door.js + companion/carry transfer → level70#l70-from-l31; Level 70 l70-back trigger → level31#l31-from-l70; quest-route.js exposes the white-door pair and preload.yml preloads each destination.

Level 31 sim reads H/B/RINK/ZONES/DOOR/BACK, rebuilds l31-* roots at place.state.v31=97 and dispatches layParts; level31.js supplies zone IDs and placement geometry, then texturePass styles eligible flat-color props.

Level 70 sim lays arrival/return trigger, snow and wind under place.state.v70, then calls town/civic/wild/life/quest lay-on-version and tick-each-second; layer modules currently export V=0 and empty lay/tick functions.

Bonus smoothie input → scripts/smoothie-player.js reads smoothies.yml, debits cents, records recipe keys and writes smoothieBuff; timed player update applies hp/sanity/food effects, while smoothieUi displays state and Sal/cutscene events present the order.

scripts/talk.js assembles authored dialogue/recorded takes; unhandled quest text → handleDialogueQuest31; Level 31 arcade usable press → level31-arcade.js initializes player.state.arcade; arcade-play.js dispatches games, and tagged seat usable/input → scripts/lib/seat.js claims a spot and updates sitter state.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored mall shops/props and simulated staff; Block Panic and Squeeze Play are separate playable counters.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; home11 and Level 5 have separate buckets.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage motion and legacy migration; Fort Surrender uses tagged paired leaves.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry/breach/hatch/bot/hazard scripts; places/level02/sim.js + l02-grid.js vary partitions, lights, crew, knocks and reset.

scripts/lib/meg-agent.js - per-NPC nerve/stats/weapon reactions, cover and authored/voiced barks; NPC state.rounds supports patrols and Meg handles movement/fighting; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances across levels.

Level 13 furnishing/dressing data and foe/people/tape layers vary rooms, story, encounters and residents; weapon data vary requirements/stats/loot while stats.js and weapon-look/fp-gun/vmpose supply handling and visuals.

scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml + art/cat-wardrobe/{eyewear,hats}.py + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - cat garment paint/model variants and fitted eyewear/headwear reused across cat looks; Level 31 modular builders vary venue subareas.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/l31-fold-table.js, scripts/l31-green-booth.js - authored procedural prop geometry files with no current path references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. Keep this bounded sweep.
Global body-style restyling skips player IDs and player/ roots and ignores local-audience or model-less objects; wardrobe membership is derived from critter-ward object IDs and passed to restyle.
Level 2 camp survivors must keep their generated look in NPC state.wear for global body restyling; survBodyV=1 triggers a one-time destroy/rebuild so survivors laid on the older body are refit.
Level 31 rebuilds l31-* roots at place.state.v31=97; align IDs and shell/zone/door/arrival geometry with level31.js, and keep the new white-door exit paired with Level 70's l70-from-l31 arrival.

Level 70 map contract is scripts/lib/level70.js: built zone discs, street and Burns River share y=0 ground; terrain70.js blends height up only outside them. Keep ARRIVE/HUT and the Level 31 return trigger aligned; place scenes contain blueprint markers for authored landmark footprints.

scripts/lib/seat.js parents a seated body to the tagged seat in seat-local coordinates; cushionLift ray-probes seat geometry unless state.seat.y overrides it. Keep seat state.by claims in step with sitter state.sit.
